title: DojoLiq Blueberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Blueberry is a timeless flavour executed with high-definition clarity. The inhale is packed with the deep, jammy sweetness of ripe Blueberry, offering a rich and authentic fruit taste. The profile remains dedicated to this single fruit, providing a pure and richly formulated berry experience that is consistently smooth and satisfying throughout the day. Formulated with a bespoke 45% VG / 55% PG ratio tailored specifically to this flavour, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is crafted to provide exceptional clarity and a smooth throat hit. This fine-tuned blend performs flawlessly with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and starter devices, ensuring sharp flavour transmission. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
